title: Generation of Conformation-Specific Monoclonal Antibodies for Integral Membrane Proteins
author: Sheldon, Dhandapani, et al.
materials: Brain polar lipid extract (Avanti Polar Lipids, cat. no. 141101)
Monophosphoryl lipid A (MPLA; Avanti Polar Lipids, cat. no. 699800)

In this protocol, verified monoclonal hybridoma lines from Basic Protocol 1 are cultured in a bioreactor system to produce mAbs at milligram‐scale quantities. These hybridoma cells can be used to sequence the antibody VH and VL genes by standard RNA extraction either in house or through a commercial source. The sequences of the VH and VL genes are used to develop new antibody fragment constructs for expression of Fab or scFv in insect cells. Baculovirus generation and large‐scale Fab expression follow established protocols outlined in our previous publications (Goehring et al., 2014; Zhao et al., 2019) (Fig. 1C).

steps.title: Culture hybridoma cells in bioreactor
steps.instruction: Grow verified monoclonal hybridoma lines in a bioreactor system to produce monoclonal antibodies at milligram‑scale quantities.

steps.title: Extract RNA and sequence VH/VL
steps.instruction: Isolate total RNA from the cultured hybridoma cells and perform VH and VL gene sequencing either in‑house or through a commercial service.

steps.title: Design Fab/scFv constructs
steps.instruction: Use the obtained VH and VL sequences to construct expression vectors for Fab or scFv fragments suitable for insect‑cell expression.

steps.title: Generate baculovirus and express Fab
steps.instruction: Produce recombinant baculovirus and carry out large‑scale Fab expression in insect cells following the protocols of Goehring et al., 2014 and Zhao et al., 2019.

steps.title: Concentrate and clarify supernatant via TFF
steps.instruction: Process 3 L of insect‑cell culture supernatant containing Fab by tangential flow filtration at room temperature to concentrate the protein, remove biotin, and eliminate macromolecular impurities smaller than 30 kDa.
